title: ENHYPEN in Mexico: How to Sign Up for the K-Pop Band’s Official Pop-Up Store, Step By Step
summary: The interactive store will return to Mexico City following last year's success.
contentText:
ENHYPEN is bringing a special experience to their fans in Mexico when the South Korean band arrives to the capital next month as part of their BLOOD SAGA world tour: an exclusive pop-up store where ENGENEs — the name for their devoted fans — can immerse themselves in a space inspired by the group and snag official band merchandise.

Returning to the country after the success of its 2025 edition, the experience will be open to the public from July 2-26 at C. Río Elba #20, Alcaldía Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City, according to Eventbrite, the agency organizing the exhibition. It will also coincide with the BLOOD SAGA tour dates on July 11, 12 and 14 at the Mexico City Arena (aka Arena CDMX).

Although entry to the store will be free, having a reservation will be a mandatory requirement to enter. Access will be organized through assigned time slots to maintain a smooth flow of visitors. Before arriving in Mexico, the pop-up store will make its first stop in Peru, where ENGENEs can enjoy the experience from July 1-12, according to Eventbrite.

In response to a request for details, HYBE Latin America told Billboard Español that it currently has no further information, as the company is not directly involved in organizing the pop-up store.

The BLOOD SAGA tour comes on the heels of ENHYPEN’s seventh mini-album, THE SIN: VANISH , which debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 with 122,000 units, marking their third album to reach the top 3 and their ninth entry on the chart.

With an immersive visual concept, a narrative inspired by their vampiric universe, and a large-scale production, ENHYPEN’s new world tour has been met with great success, including three sold-out shows in Seoul before heading to Latin America.

Comprised of JUNGWON, JAY, JAKE, SUNGHOON, SUNOO and NI-KI, ENHYPEN has quickly risen to global stardom as a powerhouse in K-pop, breaking records since their debut in 2020. They burst onto the scene with their debut mini-album BORDER: DAY ONE , making an immediate impact with unique concepts that defined their artistic identity. HEESEUNG recently left the group to pursue a solo career.

In just three years, ENHYPEN has landed three albums in the top 10 of the Billboard 200: MANIFESTO: DAY 1 (2022), DARK BLOOD (2023), and ORANGE BLOOD (2023), debuting at No. 6, No. 4, and No. 4, respectively. Their second studio album, ROMANCE: UNTOLD (2024), reached No. 2 on the Billboard 200 — their highest chart position to date — and was the top ranked album among K-pop acts on the IFPI Global Album Chart 2024.

- First, you’ll need to register on the Eventbrite platform.

- Select Mexico City as the location.

- Choose your desired date.

- Pick an available time slot.

- Confirm your reservation.

- The system will send a QR code to the registered email address. You’ll need to show this code upon entry to the venue.
